legal_about_summary: The mission and values of SMLQUIZ Pro.
legal_about_text_0: SMLQUIZ Pro was created to make university practice more organized, accessible, and measurable. We aim to help students identify what they know, recognize gaps, and practice consistently.
legal_about_text_1: We believe in clear questions, useful explanations, transparent feedback, and tools that support structured study. The platform is evolving, and user reports help improve it.
legal_about_text_2: The operator’s identity and support contact details are not published in this version. They will be required for public and commercial service delivery.
